setup: Write q=a/b in lowest positive terms and [T:S] for the projective t-parameter. The K_{q,d} quartic supplies the B_h=d*v^2 condition after parameterizing A_h=d*u^2. A rational genus-5 cover point therefore gives a rational K_{q,d} point and an E_q point with the same projective x-coordinate.

d1.proof: If T^2=S^2 and T*S=0 then T=S=0, impossible in P^1.
d1.pole_proof: x/q=+1 gives t^2-2t-1=0 and x/q=-1 gives t^2+2t-1=0; both have discriminant 8 and no rational root.
d1.receiver_exception: The two rational t-points above x=infinity project to the elliptic origin O, hence have zero free part and are outside the audited non-torsion receiver population.

d2.proof: A common zero would satisfy 2*T^2=S^2 and 2*T^2-4*T*S+S^2=0, hence 2*S*(S-2*T)=0; combining with 2*T^2=S^2 forces T=S=0 over characteristic zero.
d2.infinity_proof: 2*T^2=S^2 has no nonzero rational projective solution because 2 is not a rational square.
d2.pole_proof: Equating the numerator to minus/plus the denominator factors respectively as 4*t*(t-1)=0 and -2*(2*t-1)=0 in the affine chart; the second +q preimage is the projective point at infinity where the leading-coefficient ratio is +1.
d2.receiver_exception: Every rational d=2 pole preimage projects to x=+/-q on E_q. The audited pole-torsion lock proves all rational E_q points above these x-values have order 4, so they are outside the non-torsion receiver population.

fiber_product_equivalence_for_receiver.forward: Every non-torsion rational C_q point has a unique surviving squareclass d in {1,2} after D1 and yields a rational K_{q,d} point plus the same E_q point with equal finite non-pole x.
fiber_product_equivalence_for_receiver.reverse: A rational E_q point and K_{q,d} point with equal finite non-pole x satisfy A=d*u^2 and B=d*v^2; then z=d*u*v gives z^2=A*B, hence a rational C_q point (up to the harmless z sign).
fiber_product_equivalence_for_receiver.receiver_target: It is therefore sufficient and exact to classify rational pairs in E_q(Q) x K_{q,d}(Q) with matching finite non-pole x, then remove zero-free-part/torsion points.
